title: BidArena - Real-Time Auction Platform
description: A full-stack real-time auction platform where users can create auctions, join live bidding rooms, place bids instantly, chat with participants, and complete payments for winning items.

title: ByteBoutique - React E-Commerce App
description: A modern React e-commerce application focused on API-driven product browsing, protected routes, authentication, product details, and data-based navigation using React Router loaders.

title: DebugBattle - Real-Time Tic-Tac-Toe
description: A full-stack multiplayer Tic-Tac-Toe game built as a debugging challenge, featuring user authentication, friends, game invitations, real-time matches, multi-round scoring, and opponent reconnect handling.

title: DOM Figma-Like Editor
description: A mini Figma-inspired design editor built with Vanilla JavaScript, allowing users to create, select, drag, resize, rotate, duplicate, lock, and manage design elements with persistent editor state.

title: Inkwell - React Blog Platform
description: A modern React blog platform where users can create, edit, publish, save drafts, and manage articles through a protected dashboard with persistent local storage and form validation.
